text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the end of January approaching,<n>the hustle
and bustle of the new year<n>has started to settle
down.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has asked me to meet<n>her at the
dorms so we can hammer<n>out a training plan.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry! I can't believe you sent<n>a car all the
way to my house to pick<n>me up...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was no trouble at all. I'm simply<n>glad to see you
back at school.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
With your debut on the horizon,<n>please know that
the student council<n>stands behind you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything you need, please<n>don't
hesitate to call on us.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Thank you, President! That really<n>means a lot!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That seems to be the last of them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. You're already here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. That was the last arrival.<n>Now the
student body is back up to its<n>full complement.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to believe that there are still<n>students
filtering back in with January<n>ending. I shake my
head in disbelief.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Often, there are several students who<n>don't come
back at all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just as they encounter the true<n>cruelty and
intensity of racing, they<n>return to the warm
embrace of their<n>family. One can hardly blame
them for<n>wanting to stay.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If that is what they truly desire, then I<n>wish them
well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But if some piece of their heart<n>remains on the
turf...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think someone should give<n>them the
push to try again one more<n>time?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Come to think about it, after our New<n>Year's
shrine visit, there was a<n>period of time when
Symboli Rudolf's<n>phone line was always busy.
choice_data_list: Have you been calling them yourself?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should leave it to Air<n>Groove and the
other student council<n>members in the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I know that I can be... imposing. They<n>would likely
be more sensitive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But after seeing how exhausted Air<n>Groove was
at the end of last year, I<n>don't want to impose my
selfishness<n>on her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, do I not seem selfish? And<n>arrogant besides.
What else would<n>you call an individual who
presumes<n>to guide the entire student body?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What I'm doing now deviates<n>significantly from
my official student<n>council responsibilities.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So I won't ask anyone else to indulge<n>me. Not
even you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, I believe we have some training<n>plans to iron
out. We ought to—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Buzz, buzz!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. That's my phone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Would you mind if I take this? It could<n>be urgent.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf speaking. How can I<n>help you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove did what?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President? Whatever is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? I heard you<n>collapsed! Is
everything all right?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry. I've made certain my<n>duties won't
be affected.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Brian has been coordinating the<n>handover—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I meant. I'm asking<n>about your
condition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Work can wait. I can catch up on any<n>deficit
afterward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If there's been a handover, the<n>doctor must have
ordered you to rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What's your diagnosis?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Apparently I'm just overworked. I<n>apologize.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What for?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who owes you anapology.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's as plain as day that preventing<n>overwork falls
on the president's<n>shoulders. If I had managed
our<n>personnel better, this never would<n>have
happened. Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You shouldn't—no, no one shouldhave to suffer for my shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Such immaturity is... infuriating.<n>Shameful.
Unforgivable.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But here and now, I swear that I will<n>redouble my
dedication to the student<n>council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And I will start by taking on a portion<n>of the work
that I've left to the rest of<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But, President... with all due respect,<n>that will
interfere with your racing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've balanced both well enough so<n>far. A little
extra weight won't tip the<n>scales.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The Emperor's road is not an easy<n>one, President.
Any additional<n>burden—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What good is an Emperor who can't<n>protect her
subjects?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You have your own dreams, do you<n>not? Dreams
of finding glory as an<n>Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What would become of those dreams<n>if you work
yourself to exhaustion?<n>The work of the student
council can't<n>take precedence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll take care of everything myself.<n>You focus on
resting and recovering.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Are we agreed?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...How dare you look down on me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is that all we are to you? Dreams for<n>you to
shepherd?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You tell me not to apologize. You say<n>it's all your
fault.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't you see? You're treating us<n>like children!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've got it all wrong, President. You<n>don't...
understand at all...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I am... We are...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove?! What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
What are you three doing?! Air<n>Groove, you
should be resting!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to have disturbed you, Air<n>Groove. I'll
come again some other<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With the benefits of rest, Air Groove<n>quickly
makes a full recovery and<n>apologizes for her
outburst.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf apologizes in kind, and<n>on the face
of it, everything seems to<n>have been resolved...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But the incident casts a long shadow<n>over Symboli
Rudolf's heart.
